title: A Verifier from the Past: Test-Time Compute for Time Series Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time compute (TTC) improves language models by spending additional inference compute to generate, verify, and select among candidate outputs, but this recipe has not transferred directly to time series forecasting. A language model can verify a proof or vote across samples, but a forecaster must be causal; it cannot use future information to score a candidate. We propose Backtest-Gated Augmentation Averaging (BGAA), a TTC algorithm for time series forecasting that builds a causal verifier from the series's own history, using rolling-origin backtests to score structured views of the context, discard those that underperform the untransformed context, and average the survivors' predictive distributions. BGAA improves every tested TSFM-benchmark combination, reducing MASE by 0.5-1.0% on GIFT-Eval, 1.3-5.0% on fev-bench, and 1.7-5.9% on BOOM, where a 313M model with TTC outperforms the 1B and 2.5B models in its family. translated_title: 来自过去的验证器：面向时间序列基础模型的测试时计算
translated_abstract: 测试时计算（TTC）通过在推理阶段投入额外算力来生成、验证并在候选输出中进行选择，从而提升语言模型的性能，但这一方法尚未能直接迁移到时间序列预测任务中。语言模型可以验证证明或在多个样本间投票，但预测模型必须保持因果性——它不能利用未来信息来评估候选输出。我们提出了回测门控增强平均（Backtest-Gated Augmentation Averaging, BGAA），这是一种面向时间序列预测的TTC算法，它利用序列自身的历史构建因果验证器：通过滚动起点回测对上下文的结构化变换视图进行评分，剔除表现不及未变换上下文的视图，并对幸存视图的预测分布进行平均。BGAA在所有测试的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）与基准的组合中均取得改进：在GIFT-Eval上MASE降低0.5-1.0%，在fev-bench上降低1.3-5.0%，在BOOM上降低1.7-5.9%；其中，采用TTC的313M参数模型超越了同一家族中1B和2.5B参数的模型。我们还进一步表明……
tldr: 提出BGAA测试时计算算法，利用时间序列自身历史通过滚动回测构建因果验证器来筛选增强上下文并平均其预测分布，使313M小模型在多个基准上超越1B和2.5B的大模型。
en_tdlr: BGAA is a test-time compute algorithm for time series forecasting that builds a causal verifier from the series's own history via rolling-origin backtests, enabling a 313M model to outperform its 1B and 2.5B family counterparts across multiple benchmarks.
